subject: NOTICE OF FORCE MAJEURE: Supply Agreement LC-2019-0044
body:
To our valued customers,

Pursuant to Section 13 of your Helium Supply Agreement, Lakeshore Cryogenics hereby declares an event of force majeure following an unplanned shutdown of our primary Amarillo source field.

Effective immediately, your monthly allocation is reduced by thirty percent (30%), from 350,000 cf to 245,000 cf, until further notice. We understand the timing is difficult for customers with seasonal obligations.

We regret the disruption and will provide updates as recovery progresses.

Lakeshore Cryogenics, Customer Notices

subject: Fleet uptime: formal notice under Section 4.2
body:
Dale,

Our dashboard shows 214 units down as of this morning, concentrated in the Midwest region. Fleet uptime is 97.0% and trending down. I want to remind you that the Wacky Waving Uptime SLA floor is 99.5% and that penalty provisions under Section 4.5 activate during promotional periods, which, as you know, is now.

I need three things by end of day: root cause, remediation timeline, and your plan to protect the summer sales event.

I also want to be transparent: we are evaluating vendors for the renewal. Make this easy for me to defend.

Deb Kowalski
Fleet Procurement, AutoPlex Collective
